items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him he will be inactive for Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix; tenure in AZ over.
items.why: Trade talks advanced; team comfortable enough to sit him pending deal completion after Sunday.
items.implication: Zero Week 5 production; long-term destination TBD (HOU interest for Stroud reunion).
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining ARI WRs

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 (with DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown also OUT for PHI).
items.implication: Eagles RB room to Shipley/Pierce committee; Smith absence opens WR targets.
items.opportunity: PHI backup RBs and remaining WRs/TE elevated roles/snaps

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5.
items.why: Ankle; confirmed on final report and insider reports.
items.implication: Ravens QB change; Flowers Q but offense impacted.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and remaining pass-catchers (Likely etc.) usage shift

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr had only 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff; Kia Kendrick Bourne szn now with trade/inactive.
items.implication: Minimal fantasy loss this week; Wilson/Bourne upside.
items.opportunity: Wilson primary beneficiary already seeing volume

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (with AD Mitchell).

items.opportunity: Ladd McConkey and other LAC WRs elevated target share

items.text: Michael Pittman listed OUT; later confirmed placed on IR (foot), miss min 4 games.
items.implication: PIT/IND? WR depth chart shift long-term.
items.opportunity: Other PIT WRs (DK Metcalf etc.) more targets

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN (expected to play).
items.why: Cleared final report after prior issues.
items.implication: WAS offense at full QB strength.
items.opportunity: Full QB play lifts surrounding skill players

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (not on final report).

Jeremiyah Love tough projection but expected much better role this week despite ankle maintenance; currently 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Fans/media dragged usage last week may help; not on final IR.
items.why: Not on final report; 'full-go'; accounting for downside of long year fatigue.
items.implication: Startable RB with clear lead over backup in projections.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs defense struggling vs WRs.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5 (pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname); gobbles targets/points, tied to Bengals injury potential and soft RB defenses.
items.why: Workload + matchup + possible WR injury boost.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume/red-zone vs soft secondary. Boosted further by MHJ inactive.
items.why: Target volume + matchup; MHJ out amplifies.
corroboration: Levitan MHJ low prior impact + Bourne note
